description: This file is an HTML document that includes embedded JavaScript and references external JavaScript files. It serves as a web form interface for creating web-to-lead forms within the SuiteCRM/Campains module, including JavaScript code for user interaction and dynamic form management.

methods.name: populatePersonTypeDropDown
methods.description: Populates a dropdown menu with options based on a list of bean objects.

methods.name: addItemsToForm
methods.description: Adds multiple hidden input fields to a specified form with given items.

methods.name: addItemToForm
methods.description: Adds a single hidden input field to a specified form.

methods.name: addTypeOfPersonToForm
methods.description: Adds a hidden input indicating the type of person for the form submission.

methods.name: populateFields
methods.description: Populates the form with selectable fields based on the selected person type; initializes drag-and-drop interactions.

methods.name: getSelectedPersonType
methods.description: Retrieves the currently selected person type index from the dropdown.

methods.name: getArrayOfItemsForForm
methods.description: Converts a set of DOM elements into an array of their values.
